name: ballerinax/postgresql
description: This module provides the functionality required to access and manipulate data stored in a PostgreSQL database. It enables seamless integration with PostgreSQL, supporting various data types and advanced database features.

typeDefs.name: Options
typeDefs.description: An additional set of options related to the PostgreSQL database connection.

fields.name: ssl
fields.description: SSL configurations to be used

fields.name: connectTimeout
fields.description: Timeout in seconds for connecting to the server

fields.name: socketTimeout
fields.description: Socket timeout in seconds for read/write operations with the server (0 means no socket timeout)

fields.name: loginTimeout
fields.description: Timeout in seconds for connecting to the server and authentication (0 means no timeout)

fields.name: rowFetchSize
fields.description: The number of rows to be fetched in one trip to the database

fields.name: cachedMetadataFieldsCount
fields.description: The maximum number of fields to be cached per connection. A value of 0 disables the cache

fields.name: cachedMetadataFieldSize
fields.description: The maximum size in megabytes of fields to be cached per connection. A value of 0 disables the cache

fields.name: preparedStatementThreshold
fields.description:
The number of `PreparedStatement` executions required before switching
over to use server-side prepared statements. A value of 0 disables the cache.

fields.name: preparedStatementCacheQueries
fields.description:
The number of queries that are cached in each connection
A value of 0 for preparedStatementThreshold disables the cache.

fields.name: preparedStatementCacheSize
fields.description:
The maximum size in mebibytes of the prepared queries
A value of 0 for preparedStatementThreshold disables the cache.

fields.name: cancelSignalTimeout
fields.description: Time in seconds for sending the cancel command out of band over its own connection

fields.name: keepAliveTcpProbe
fields.description: Enable or disable the TCP keep-alive probe

fields.name: binaryTransfer
fields.description: Use the binary format for sending and receiving data if possible

fields.name: currentSchema
fields.description: The schema to be used by the client

typeDefs.name: SecureSocket
typeDefs.description: The SSL configurations to be used when connecting to the PostgreSQL server.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: The `postgresql:SSLMode` to be used during the connection

fields.name: rootcert
fields.description:
File name of the SSL root certificate. Defaults to the `defaultdir/root.crt`.
in which the `defaultdir` is `${user.home}/.postgresql/` in Unix systems and
`%appdata%/postgresql/` on Windows.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Keystore configuration of the client certificates

typeDefs.name: SSLMode
typeDefs.description: Possible values for the SSL mode.

typeDefs.name: CertKey
typeDefs.description: Represents the combination of the certificate, the private key, and the private key password if encrypted

fields.name: certFile
fields.description: The client certificate file

fields.name: keyFile
fields.description: The client private key file

fields.name: keyPassword
fields.description: Password of the private key if it is encrypted

typeDefs.name: PostgreSQLLogicalDecodingPlugin
typeDefs.description: Represents the PostgreSQL logical decoding plugins.

fields.name: pluginName
fields.description: Logical decoding plugin to use (pgoutput, decoderbufs)

fields.name: slotName
fields.description: Name of the PostgreSQL logical replication slot

fields.name: slotDropOnStop
fields.description: Drop replication slot when connector stops

fields.name: slotStreamParams
fields.description: Custom replication slot parameters

fields.name: publicationName
fields.description: Name of PostgreSQL publication

fields.name: publicationAutocreateMode
fields.description: Mode for auto-creating publications

fields.name: statusUpdateInterval
fields.description: Interval for sending status updates to PostgreSQL in seconds

fields.name: xminFetchInterval
fields.description: Interval for fetching current xmin position in seconds

fields.name: lsnFlushMode
fields.description: LSN flushing strategy

typeDefs.name: PostgresDatabaseConnection
typeDefs.description: Represents the configuration for the Postgres CDC database connection.

fields.name: connectorClass
fields.description: The class name of the PostgreSQL connector implementation to use

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: The hostname of the PostgreSQL server

fields.name: port
fields.description: The port number of the PostgreSQL server

fields.name: databaseName
fields.description: The name of the PostgreSQL database from which to stream the changes.

fields.name: includedSchemas
fields.description: A list of regular expressions matching fully-qualified schema identifiers to capture changes from

fields.name: excludedSchemas
fields.description: A list of regular expressions matching fully-qualified schema identifiers to exclude from change capture

fields.name: includedTables
fields.description: Regex patterns for tables to capture (mutually exclusive with `excludedTables`)

fields.name: excludedTables
fields.description: Regex patterns for tables to exclude (mutually exclusive with `includedTables`)

fields.name: includedColumns
fields.description: Regex patterns for columns to capture (mutually exclusive with `excludedColumns`)

fields.name: excludedColumns
fields.description: Regex patterns for columns to exclude (mutually exclusive with `includedColumns`)

fields.name: messageKeyColumns
fields.description: Composite message key columns for change events

fields.name: tasksMax
fields.description: The PostgreSQL connector always uses a single task and therefore does not use this value, so the default is always acceptable

fields.name: pluginName
fields.description: Deprecated: Use `replicationConfig.pluginName` instead

fields.name: slotName
fields.description: Deprecated: Use `replicationConfig.slotName` instead

fields.name: publicationName
fields.description: Deprecated: Use `publicationConfig.publicationName` instead

fields.name: replicationConfig
fields.description: Replication configuration (logical decoding plugin, slot name and parameters). Takes priority over deprecated top-level fields

fields.name: publicationConfig
fields.description: Publication configuration (publication name and autocreate mode). Takes priority over deprecated top-level fields

typeDefs.name: CdcListener
typeDefs.description: Initializes the Postgresql listener with the given configuration.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the Postgresql listener with the given configuration.

parameters.name: engineName
parameters.description: Debezium engine instance name

parameters.name: internalSchemaStorage
parameters.description: Schema history storage configuration

parameters.name: offsetStorage
parameters.description: Offset storage configuration

parameters.name: livenessInterval
parameters.description: Interval in seconds for checking CDC listener liveness

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Database connection configuration (provided by DB-specific listener configs)

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Connector options

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The configuration for the Postgresql connector

functions.name: attach
functions.description: Attaches a CDC service to the Postgresql listener.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: The CDC service to attach

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Attachment points

return.description: An `cdc:Error` if the service cannot be attached, or `()` if successful

functions.name: 'start
functions.description: Starts the Postgresql listener.

functions.name: detach
functions.description: Detaches a CDC service from the Postgresql listener.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: The CDC service to detach

return.description: An `cdc:Error` if the service cannot be detached, or `()` if successful

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description: Stops the Postgresql listener gracefully.

return.description: An `cdc:Error` if the listener cannot be stopped, or `()` if successful

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description: Stops the Postgresql listener immediately.

return.description: An `cdc:Error` if the listener cannot be stopped, or `()` if successful

clients.name: Client
clients.description: PostgreSQL database client that enables interaction with PostgreSQL servers and supports standard SQL operations.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Connects to a PostgreSQL database with the specified configuration.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: PostgreSQL server hostname

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Database password

parameters.name: database
parameters.description:
Database name to connect to. The default is to connect to a database with the
same name as the username

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: PostgreSQL server port

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The advanced connection options specific to the PostgreSQL database.

parameters.name: connectionPool
parameters.description: The `sql:ConnectionPool` object to be used within the client. If not provided, the global connection pool (shared by all clients) will be used

return.description: An `sql:Error` if the client creation fails

functions.name: query
functions.description: Executes a SQL query and returns multiple results as a stream.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query as `sql:ParameterizedQuery` (e.g., `` `SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=${userId}` ``)

parameters.name: rowType
parameters.description: The `typedesc` of the record type to which the result needs to be mapped

return.description: Stream of records containing the query results. Please ensure that the stream is fully consumed, or close the stream.

functions.name: queryRow
functions.description: Executes a SQL query that is expected to return a single row or value as the result.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query as `sql:ParameterizedQuery` (e.g., `` `SELECT * from Album WHERE name=${albumName}` ``)

parameters.name: returnType
parameters.description:
The `typedesc` of the anydata (record or basic type) to which the result needs to be returned.
It can be a basic type if the query result contains only one column

return.description:
The result of the query or an `sql:Error`.
- If the query does not return any results, an `sql:NoRowsError` is returned.
- If the query returns multiple rows, only the first row is returned.

functions.name: execute
functions.description:
Executes a SQL query and returns execution metadata (not the actual query results).
This function is typically used for operations like `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, or `DELETE`.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query as `sql:ParameterizedQuery` (e.g., `` `DELETE FROM Album WHERE artist=${artistName}` ``)

return.description: The execution metadata as an `sql:ExecutionResult`, or an `sql:Error` if execution fails

functions.name: batchExecute
functions.description:
Executes a SQL query with multiple sets of parameters in a single batch operation and returns execution metadata (not the actual query results).
This function is typically used for batch operations like `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, or `DELETE`.

parameters.name: sqlQueries
parameters.description: The SQL query with multiple sets of parameters as an array of `sql:ParameterizedQuery`

return.description: The execution metadata as an array of `sql:ExecutionResult` or an `sql:Error`. If one of the commands in the batch fails, an `sql:BatchExecuteError` will be returned immediately

functions.name: call
functions.description: Calls a stored procedure with the given SQL query.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query to call the procedure as `sql:ParameterizedQuery` (e.g., `` `CALL get_user(${id})` ``)

parameters.name: rowTypes
parameters.description: An array of `typedesc` of the record type to which the result needs to be mapped

return.description: The summary of the execution and results are returned in an `sql:ProcedureCallResult`, or an `sql:Error`. Once the results are processed, invoke the `close` method on the `sql:ProcedureCallResult`.

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the PostgreSQL client and shuts down the connection pool.
The client should be closed only at the end of the application lifetime, or when performing graceful stops in a service.

return.description: `sql:Error` if closing the client fails, else `()`
